footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss: includes an $8K income tax benefit, $65K from other items, net.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 8.0% to $21.7M in 2025. The operating loss narrowed to $101M from $105M.
The net loss narrowed to $93.4M, or −$0.51 per share, from $96.5M. Operating cash flow was −$73.4M and free cash flow −$83.6M, versus −$79.8M; Solid Power returned $3.6M through buybacks.
sources: Solid Power, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)

risks: The pace of battery technology development is not predictable
We may not successfully develop our electrolyte for commercialization or attract customers
It will be challenging to develop sulfide-based solid electrolyte capable of production at volume and with acceptable performance, yields, and costs
We may not successfully commercially license our cell technology to OEMs or cell manufacturers or generate material revenue from our cell technology
We have only conducted preliminary safety testing on our cells
